battle.name: 蒙古第二次西征
battle.theater: 匈牙利大平原與紹約河畔
battle.brief: 1237年12月梁贖陷落，1238年錫季河戰役殺大公尤里二世，1240年12月基輔陷落，1241年4月萊格尼察與穆希兩役重創波蘭、匈牙利聯軍，蒙古軍冬渡多瑙河攻布達，追貝拉四世至亞得里亞海，1242年3月全軍回撤。卡面拜占庭希臘火並未隨軍西來，戰場上燃燒的是南宋火矢與投石機火彈。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 交戰的一方是蒙古帝國的西征軍。1235年大汗窩闊台在库里台上下令，由朮赤之子拔都掛帥，合丹、貴由、拜答里等宗王分路配合，速不台任全軍策劃。兵員結構極為雜湊：蒙古本族騎兵只佔少數，七至八成是草原突厥語族——欽察、伏爾加保加爾、伏爾加韃靼、哈薩克與維吾爾部眾，另有華北漢人、波斯伊朗人、高加索居民與被征服的羅斯人被徵為步卒和工匠。軍中文官與稅吏多是伊朗人，負責戶口調查、徵調哈沙爾輔助兵與徵稅；攻城器械則由華人與回回工匠操作，隨軍推進。 另一方是當時分裂的歐洲諸邦與羅斯諸公國：弗拉基米爾-蘇茲達爾、梁贖、佩列亞斯拉夫、切爾尼戈夫、斯摩棱斯克、羅斯托夫、圖羅夫-平斯克、切爾尼戈夫與加利西亞-沃倫等公國，加上諾夫哥羅德；中歐方面是皮亞斯圖斯王朝的波蘭王國、阿爾帕德王朝的匈牙利王國、克羅地亞與達爾馬提亞王國、波希米亞王國、邁森藩侯國、奧地利公國與神聖羅馬帝國諸侯；巴爾幹方面有塞爾維亞王國、保加利亞第二帝國與拉丁帝國。匈牙利陣中還有受庇護的庫曼可汗可泰安部眾，波蘭聯軍中則有條頓與聖殿騎士團。蒙古軍攻陷基輔之後，把羅斯各公國的兵力整批徵調，用來對付波蘭、匈牙利與帝國。
countriesEn: The opposing side was the western expeditionary army of the Mongol Empire. In 1235 the Great Khan Ogedei, at a kurultai, ordered the campaign: Batu, son of Jochi, took supreme command, with the princes Kadan, Guyuk and Baydar operating on separate axes and Subutai serving as the planner of the whole operation. The manpower was extraordinarily mixed. The Mongols proper formed only a minority of the ranks; seven to eight tenths were Turkic-speaking nomads of the steppe — Kipchaks, Volga Bulgars, Volga Tatars, Kazakhs and Uyghurs — and there were further drafts of Han Chinese from North China, Iranians from Persia, highland peoples of the Caucasus, and conquered Rus' taken into service as foot soldiers and technicians. The civil administration of the army was largely in Iranian hands: they ran the census, levied the auxiliary infantry known as the khashar, and collected taxes, while the siege engines were worked by Chinese and Muslim engineers who advanced with the column. On the other side stood the divided principalities of Rus' and the states of Central and South-Eastern Europe. In Rus' the campaign fell on Vladimir-Suzdal, Ryazan, Pereyaslav, Chernigov, Smolensk, Rostov, Turov-Pinsk, Novgorod and the Galicia-Volhynia appanages; in Central Europe it fell on the Polish kingdom of the Piast dynasty, the Hungarian kingdom of the Arpad dynasty, the Croatian and Dalmatian kingdom, the Bohemian kingdom, the Margraviate of Meissen, the Duchy of Austria and the princes of the Holy Roman Empire; in the Balkans on the Serbian kingdom, the Second Bulgarian Empire and the Latin Empire. The Hungarian host included the Cumans of the khan Kotyan, who had been given asylum, while the Polish coalition contained the Teutonic and the Templar knights. After the fall of Kiev the Mongols conscripted Rus' troops in bulk and used them against Poland, Hungary and the Empire.
people: 蒙古一方的關鍵人物是速不台。中歐戰役的整體構思、偵察部署與三路進軍方案都出自他手，他既統率攻羅斯南北兩線的兵，也在匈牙利平原上指揮中路大軍。拔都是名分上的最高統帥，實際上前線的戰略決定幾乎都由速不台作出；拔都也負責接受匈牙利人的歸附，之後把匈牙利土地劃給斡兒答作封地。合丹是追擊匈牙利國王貝拉四世的那一路主將，率數個圖們追入克羅埃西亞、塞爾維亞與保加利亞，並曾向拜占庭邊境用兵；貴由在特蘭西瓦尼亞作戰，拜答里與合丹在西里西亞、摩拉維亞一線劫掠。1241到1243年安納托利亞的戰事由別兒哥主持，同一戰役中塞爾柱人以火陷阱重創蒙古騎兵。 歐洲一方，匈牙利國王貝拉四世是全場最關鍵的防守方指揮者：他兩度拒絕拔都的通牒，接納庫曼可汗可泰安，又在戰前夜失去這位盟友，最後在穆希之戰被包圍。波蘭方面以西里西亞公爵兼大波蘭公爵「虔誠者」亨里克二世為主，萊格尼察的聯軍還包括莫拉維亞諸侯與聖殿騎士團。波希米亞國王瓦茨拉夫一世因遲到一日而保住王國，奧地利公爵腓特烈二世在奧洛穆茨與維也納一線抵擋；保加利亞沙皇伊凡·阿森二世在貝爾瓦德擊敗過一支蒙古分隊。蒙古一方的技術骨幹不是蒙古人，而是隨軍的華人與回回攻城工程師；1237年把拔都通牒送到貝拉手上的，是道明會修士尤利安努斯。
peopleEn: On the Mongol side the key figure was Subutai. The conception of the Central European campaign, the deployment of scouts and the three-axis advance were all his work; he led the northern and southern drives against the Rus' principalities in person and commanded the central column on the Hungarian plain. Batu was the commander in name, but almost every tactical decision on the line was Subutai's, and it was Batu who accepted the Hungarian submission and afterwards carved out the Hungarian land as a fief for Ogedai. Kadan led the force that pursued King Bela IV, taking several tumens into Croatia, Serbia and Bulgaria and turning the Byzantine frontier; Guyuk fought in Transylvania, while Baydar and Kadan raided Silesia and Moravia. The Anatolian operations of 1241 to 1243 were directed by Berke, and in that same fighting the Seljuks of Rum cut up a Mongol wing with a fire trap. The most important defensive commander in Europe was King Bela IV of Hungary, who twice refused Batu's ultimatum, took in the Cuman khan Kotyan, and lost that ally on the eve of the invasion, only to be enveloped at Mohi. On the Polish side the host was led by Henry II the Pious, duke of Silesia and grand duke of Greater Poland, with the Moravian lords and the Templars in his ranks. Wenceslaus I of Bohemia, a day late for Liegnitz, saved his kingdom; Frederick II of Austria held the line at Olomouc and around Vienna; Ivan Asen II of Bulgaria beat a Mongol detachment at the Battle of Klisura. The technical backbone of the Mongol army was not Mongol at all but the Chinese and Muslim engineers who came with it, and it was the Dominican friar Julian who carried Batu's ultimatum to Bela in 1237.
kits: 卡面這件希臘火是七世紀拜占庭帝國的秘密兵器：稠厚難熄的燃燒劑灌在銅管裡，由操作手以人力泵推送，噴向水面或牆根；帝國把配方列為最高機密，傳說配方隨一艘沉船一同失落，此後再沒有第二套辦法。它的戰術任務只有一個——用火封住正在移動的對手。管口小、射程短，它從來不是野戰投射兵器，而是船首與城牆上的近距離阻斷工具，678年的桅桿海戰與717到718年的君士坦丁堡之圍，是它最後幾次成建制的使用。 希臘火沒有出現在1236到1242年的任何一處戰場上，蒙古人沒有這種裝備，羅斯、波蘭、匈牙利各軍也沒有；配方失落六百年後，東亞與東歐都不可能再複製它。真正可以對照的，是這場西征裡確實出現過的燃燒與火器手段。第一是火矢：1241年12月25日蒙古軍攻擊布達時，同時代史料明確記下他們使用中國南宋的火矢，以火箭焚燒城內防禦並最終奪城。第二是火藥與火器：穆希之戰的同時代記載提到蒙古軍用投石機拋擲炸彈與火器，有學者據此主張火藥經由蒙古人西傳歐洲。第三是投石機與攻城塔：華人與回回工匠操作的重型投石機在羅斯戰線摧毀木構防禦，埃斯泰爾戈姆一役，三十台攻城器械打成一片，守軍仍死守。第四是火作為威懾手段：邁森、托爾若克、科澤利斯克、薩格勒布大教堂相繼被焚毀，蒙古人用火把不肯降的城堡與城市逐個清空。 與希臘火最接近的一次實際交手，出現在西征剛結束的安納托利亞：1243年闊亦田之戰，塞爾柱人把浸透油料的草料點燃，在峽谷裡造出一道火牆，蒙古騎兵與戰馬陷在煙火之中，遭到重創。那是這條西征線上最像希臘火野戰版的一役。
kitsEn: The Greek fire on this card is the secret weapon of the seventh-century Byzantine Empire: a thick burning fluid, hard to extinguish, poured into bronze tubes and pushed out by hand pumps worked by the men on the ship, sprayed at the waterline or at the foot of a wall. The empire kept the formula as its highest secret, and the story runs that it was lost with a ship that sank, so that no second way of making it was ever found. Its tactical task was a single one — to use fire to seal a target that was moving. The bore was small and the reach short, so it was never a field projectile but a close-range blocking tool for ship bows and city walls; the Battle of the Masts in 678 and the defence of Constantinople in 717 to 718 were the last occasions on which it was used as a formed unit. Greek fire appeared on no battlefield of 1236 to 1242. The Mongols had nothing of the kind, and neither the Rus', the Poles nor the Hungarians had it; six centuries after the formula was lost, neither East Asia nor Eastern Europe could reproduce it. What can genuinely be set beside it is the burning and fire weapon practice that this campaign did produce. First, fire arrows: on 25 December 1241 the Mongol army attacked Buda, and the contemporary sources record explicitly that they used fire arrows from Southern Song China, setting the defences inside the town alight before the city fell. Second, gunpowder and incendiaries: the accounts of Mohi describe the Mongols throwing bombs and other fire weapons from trebuchets, and scholars have argued from this that gunpowder reached Europe with the Mongols. Third, the trebuchets and siege towers: heavy engines worked by Chinese and Muslim engineers broke up the wooden defences of the Rus' towns, and at Esztergom thirty such machines beat the place down while the garrison held on. Fourth, fire as a means of terror: Meissen, Torzhok, Kozelsk and the cathedral at Zagreb were burned in turn, and the Mongols used fire to empty out the castles and towns that refused to surrender. The closest thing to Greek fire actually meeting the Mongols in the field came in Anatolia immediately after the withdrawal: at the Battle of Kose Dag in 1243 the Seljuks set oil-soaked straw alight to raise a wall of fire in the defile, and the Mongol horse and riders, caught in the smoke and flame, were cut up. That was the closest thing to a field version of Greek fire on this western axis.
tactics: 蒙古軍的戰法核心是距離與速度。進攻前先以小股騎兵試探，1239到1240年拔都派分遣隊去試波蘭的虛實，一支被波蘭人擊敗，另一支擊敗波蘭軍後撤回，得到的情報決定了下一步的投入。中歐戰役分三路：一路攻波蘭方向，一路翻越喀爾巴阡山，一路沿多瑙河推進，最後在匈牙利大平原會合。 接戰後蒙古人不與重騎兵硬碰，維持射擊距離，用複合弓齊射壓制，再以包抄切斷退路。穆希之戰最能說明這一點：蒙古軍隱蔽主力，於1241年4月10日夜襲紹約河畔的匈牙利營地，匈牙利弩手的反擊超出預期、造成相當損失，蒙古人隨即調整，反過來擊潰全軍，並在陣形中故意留出一道缺口，誘使潰兵湧入；逃散者失去組織，多人或死於亂軍，或溺斃在紹約河水中。國王貝拉四世靠親衛突圍脫身。 攻城是另一套本領。蒙古人先以投石機破壞城頭木構與塔樓，再以火矢與焚燒配合，最後在缺口處驅趕守軍。埃斯泰爾戈姆是這一整套攻城法的極限：三十台器械打成一片，守軍仍守到蒙古軍撤退；克利斯要塞迫使蒙古兵下馬攀崖，巷戰慘烈。反過來，歐洲守軍也學會了幾招：波希米亞以山隘與石堡遲滯蒙古騎兵，維也納與克羅埃西亞的守軍在山地與林間伏擊，匈牙利與波蘭把兵力和糧秣收攏到石築堡壘之中，令蒙古軍的攻城器械無從施展。
tacticsEn: The core of Mongol method was distance and speed. Before committing they probed with small detachments: between 1239 and 1240 Batu sent a detachment to test the Poles, one was beaten back by the Poles and another defeated Polish troops and withdrew, and the intelligence gained decided the next deployment. The Central European campaign ran on three axes — one towards Poland, one over the Carpathians, one along the Danube — and the columns finally met on the Hungarian plain. Once contact was made the Mongols refused to trade blows with heavy cavalry. They held the range, pressed with volleys from the composite bow, and cut off the retreat by encircling. Mohi shows this best: the Mongols concealed the main body, attacked the Hungarian camp on the bank of the Sajo by night on 10 April 1241, took more damage than expected from the Hungarian crossbowmen, adjusted, and then broke the army; they deliberately left a gap in their line to draw the panic-stricken soldiers into it, and the fugitives, once their order dissolved, were killed in the rout or drowned in the Sajo. Bela IV escaped with his personal guard. Siege was a different craft. The Mongols first broke the wooden headworks and towers with stone-throwers, added fire arrows and deliberate burning, and finally drove the defenders out through the breaches. Esztergom marks the limit of that whole method: thirty machines battered the place and the garrison held until the Mongols withdrew, while the Klis fortress forced the Mongols to dismount and climb the cliffs, and the street fighting there was savage. The Europeans, for their part, learned a few answers: Bohemia used the mountain passes and stone castles to slow the Mongol horse, the garrisons of Vienna and Croatia ambushed them in the hills and woods, and Hungary and Poland pulled men and stores into their stone fortresses, where the Mongol siege engines had nothing to work on.
data: 關於數字要先講清楚：本作戰一覽把這場西征繫於1236年，而絕大多數戰鬥實際發生在1237到1242年之間；維基百科的戰爭列表把整段行動歸在1236年，本篇沿用這個年分，月份則取大軍西進的第一個月，即1236年夏天先入高加索與草原、擊敗阿蘭人的那一段。 時間上，這是一場為期約六年的戰爭：1235年下令，1236年開拔，1237年12月打到梁贖，1238年3月4日錫季河戰役弗拉基米爾大公尤里二世陣亡，1240年12月6日基輔陷落，1241年4月9日萊格尼察、4月11日穆希兩役相繼爆發，1241年12月11日窩闊台汗病逝於行獵途中，1242年3月下旬大軍開始回撤，年中完全退出中歐。縱深方面，戰線從伏爾加下游經基輔、喀爾巴阡山、匈牙利大平原一直推到亞得里亞海岸，縱橫逾兩千公里。兵員：蒙古本族只佔少數，七至八成為突厥語族草原部眾，中歐戰役的總兵力常被估為十餘萬。 其他可核對的數字：穆希之戰前匈牙利軍隊約六萬人；萊格尼察的聖殿騎士團只出六十五至八十八人，陣亡三名騎士與兩名軍士；埃斯泰爾戈姆一役蒙古人用三十台攻城器械；布達在1241年12月25日被火矢攻破；追擊貝拉四世的合丹所部以數個圖們計，約兩萬武裝人員；德韋尼之戰奧地利方面估蒙古軍損失三百至七百餘人，自身損失一百人；蒙古人每名戰士配三至五匹馬，到1242年春季匈牙利大平原牧場枯竭；匈牙利平原五至八成的聚落被毀，全國僅約八十處設防據點存留。距離與損失只能取大概，因為雙方都沒有留下完整的統計。
dataEn: One thing about the numbers must be cleared up first: this list dates the campaign to 1236, while almost all of the fighting took place between 1237 and 1242. Wikipedia's list of wars files the whole operation under 1236, and this account keeps that year; the month is taken from the first campaigning of the western drive, the summer of 1236 when the columns entered the Caucasus and the steppe and broke the Alans. In time this was a war of roughly six years: ordered in 1235, the columns moved out in 1236, reached Ryazan in December 1237, saw Grand Prince Yuri II killed at the Battle of the Sit River on 4 March 1238, took Kiev on 6 December 1240, fought Liegnitz on 9 April 1241 and Mohi on 11 April, lost the Great Khan on 11 December 1241 during a hunt, and began the withdrawal in the last third of March 1242, leaving Central Europe entirely by mid-year. In depth the front ran from the lower Volga through Kiev, the Carpathians and the Hungarian plain to the Adriatic coast, more than two thousand kilometres. On the numbers of men: the Mongols proper were a minority, seven to eight tenths of the army being Turkic-speaking steppe peoples, and the Central European force is commonly put at something over a hundred thousand. Other figures can be checked: the Hungarian army numbered about sixty thousand before Mohi; the Templars at Liegnitz numbered only sixty-five to eighty-eight men and lost three knights and two sergeants; thirty siege engines worked at Esztergom; Buda fell to fire arrows on 25 December 1241; Kadan's pursuing force, counted in several tumens, amounted to about twenty thousand men; at Deveny the Austrians reckoned Mongol losses at three hundred to more than seven hundred against a hundred lost on their own side; each Mongol warrior carried three to five horses, and by the spring of 1242 the pastures of the Hungarian plain were exhausted; between fifty and eighty per cent of the settlements of the plain were destroyed, and only some eighty fortified sites survived in the kingdom. Distances and losses can only be approximated, since neither side left complete figures.
cause: 起因有兩層，一層在蒙古，一層在歐洲。蒙古方面，草原帝國在1211到1225年間已完成對西夏、金與花剌子模的征服，窩闊台即汗位後要做的第一件事，是把剛被征服者的技術與人力編進帝國的戰爭機器，並把西部邊疆收束到伏爾加河下游。1235年的库里台上，他命拔都率諸王公西征，名義是討平尚未臣服的草原殘部——庫曼汗國、伏爾加保加爾、阿蘭人，實際目標還包括羅斯諸公國的臣服與進貢，以及打通西行的道路。 歐洲方面的藉口是貝拉四世收留了逃亡的魯塞尼亞波雅爾貴族，又在1239年庫曼人戰敗後接納庫曼可汗可泰安及其部眾。蒙古人視之為收容叛逆者；同時波蘭與匈牙利之間本有衝突，貝拉的支持者更以「Poloniam」指稱波蘭，把波蘭說成匈牙利地盤，蒙古人正好利用這種歐洲王國之間的矛盾作為用兵的口實。1237年道明會修士尤利安努斯帶著拔都的通牒抵達布達，要求無條件投降；貝拉沒有回應，又向教宗與西歐求援，得來的外援只有奧地利公爵腓特烈二世率領的一支小型騎士分隊。
causeEn: The cause has two layers, one in Mongolia and one in Europe. In the Mongol case, the steppe empire had finished conquering the Western Xia, the Jin and the Khwarazmian state between 1211 and 1225, and the first thing Ogedei did on taking the khanship was to fold the skills and manpower of the conquered into the empire's war machine and to close the western frontier down to the lower Volga. At the kurultai of 1235 he ordered Batu and the princes to march west: nominally to punish the steppe powers that had not yet submitted — the Kumans, the Volga Bulgars, the Alans — but in practice also to bring the Rus' principalities to submission and tribute and to open the road west. On the European side the pretext was Bela IV's reception of the exiled Ruthenian boyars and, after the Cuman defeat of 1239, his taking in of the Cuman khan Kotyan and his warriors. The Mongols read this as harbouring rebels. Poland and Hungary were also at odds with one another, and Bela's supporters called Poland Poloniam, claiming it as Hungarian territory, so the Mongols were able to exploit the quarrels between the European kingdoms as a reason to act. In 1237 the Dominican friar Julian reached Buda with Batu's ultimatum, which demanded unconditional surrender. Bela sent no answer; he turned to the pope and to western Europe for help, and the only foreign aid that came was a small body of knights led by Frederick II, duke of Austria.
impact: 直接後果是東歐被重新編排。羅斯諸公國淪入金帳汗國的秩序之中：蒙古官員在伏爾加河下游設立達魯花赤，進行戶口調查，徵調羅斯人充當哈沙爾輔助兵，羅斯軍隊甚至被整批徵用，隨蒙古軍去攻波蘭、匈牙利與帝國——這是受蒙古指揮的羅斯軍第一次成建制地出現在歐洲中部。往後一百多年，羅斯諸公向金帳汗國進貢、遣使，並在兵源與稅負上被反覆抽取，後來莫斯科的崛起與俄羅斯國家的形成，都建立在這段被編入汗國體系的經歷之上。 中歐的變化更為具體。匈牙利在穆希慘敗後由貝拉四世重建：王室遷都布達，頒下1242年的金璽詔書，重建以石築堡壘為骨架的國防體系——這正是蒙古人攻不下來的東西；匈牙利同時吸收猶太居民與逃亡的庫曼人，軍制上開始保留草原式的輕騎。波希米亞因瓦茨拉夫一世的山隘防禦，成為中歐少數未遭蹂躪的王國；波蘭與帝國諸侯則改為深壕高牆的堡壘政策。技術層面的影響更長久：隨軍的華人與回回工程師把投石機、攻城塔、火矢與火藥武器帶到中歐，火藥經蒙古人西傳的假說此後成為歐洲火器史的重要命題；而西方教會原本各自為戰，1241年後數年中歐諸侯之間的內戰一度暫停，直到蒙古軍退去才重新開始。
impactEn: The immediate consequence was that Eastern Europe was reordered. The Rus' principalities were drawn into the order of the Golden Horde: Mongol officials set up darughachis in the lower Volga, conducted censuses, levied Rus' men as khashar auxiliaries, and even conscripted entire Rus' armies to march with the Mongols against Poland, Hungary and the Empire — the first time that Rus' troops under Mongol command appeared in the middle of Europe in formed units. For more than a century the princes paid tribute to the Golden Horde, sent envoys, and were repeatedly drained of soldiers and taxes; the later rise of Moscow and the formation of the Russian state both rest on this experience of being enrolled in the Horde's system. The changes in Central Europe were more concrete. Hungary was rebuilt by Bela IV after the disaster at Mohi: the court moved to Buda, the Golden Bull of 1242 was issued, and a national defence based on stone castles was raised — the very thing the Mongols could not take. Hungary also took in Jewish households and the fugitive Cumans, and began to keep steppe-style light horse in its own order of battle. Bohemia, saved by Wenceslaus I's defence of the passes, was one of the few kingdoms in Central Europe that was not ravaged, while Poland and the Empire's princes turned to the policy of deep ditches and high walls. The technological legacy lasted longer: the Chinese and Muslim engineers carried with the army brought trebuchets, siege towers, fire arrows and gunpowder weapons into Central Europe, and the hypothesis that gunpowder travelled west with the Mongols has remained a standing proposition in the history of European firearms. And the West, which had spent the preceding decades fighting its own wars, suspended much of the internecine conflict of the central European princes for several years after 1241, only to resume it once the Mongols had gone.
result: 結果是蒙古軍在萊格尼察與穆希兩役重創波蘭與匈牙利聯軍，攻陷基輔，焚毀邁森、托爾若克、科澤利斯克等城，渡多瑙河深入潘諾尼亞，攻下布達，圍埃斯泰爾戈姆而未能取之，追擊貝拉四世直至亞得里亞海沿岸，又洗劫塞爾維亞的澤塔與保加利亞邊境；但蒙古人在歐洲並未建立永久統治，1242年3月下旬起全軍回撤，年中完全退出中歐。 退軍的原因至今沒有定論：大汗窩闊台於1241年12月11日病逝，宗王爭位使速不台被召回，是最常被引用的解釋；樹輪氣象資料顯示當地氣候轉濕、草原沼澤化，牧場枯竭削弱了蒙古複合弓的威力，同樣被用來解釋；此外，歐洲石築堡壘讓蒙古人陷於代價高昂的攻堅戰，匈牙利平原上守軍的抵抗與克羅埃西亞的伏擊都造成實損，庫曼人的叛亂也牽制了拔都。拔都其後以伏爾加河為中心建立金帳汗國，匈牙利、波蘭與波希米亞因此取得數十年喘息，並在往後的第二次金帳汗國西征中，已能用石堡與輕騎應付。
resultEn: The result was that the Mongol army mauled the Polish and Hungarian coalitions at Liegnitz and Mohi, took Kiev, burned Meissen, Torzhok, Kozelsk and other towns, crossed the Danube deep into Pannonia, took Buda, besieged Esztergom without taking it, pursued Bela IV to the Adriatic coast and stripped the Serbian Zeta and the Bulgarian border; but the Mongols established no lasting rule in Europe, and from the last third of March 1242 the whole army began to withdraw, leaving Central Europe entirely by mid-year. The reason for the withdrawal is still unsettled. The death of the Great Khan Ogedei on 11 December 1241 and the ensuing struggle over the khanship, which recalled Subutai, is the most frequently cited explanation; tree-ring evidence for a wetter climate that turned the steppe into marsh, and the exhaustion of the pastures, which blunted the Mongol composite bow, are used in the same way. In addition, the stone fortresses of Europe dragged the Mongols into costly siege warfare, the resistance of the Hungarian plain and the Croatian ambushes cost them real losses, and Cuman revolts tied Batu down. Batu afterwards built the Golden Horde around the Volga, and Hungary, Poland and Bohemia gained a decade of respite, so that when the Golden Horde came west again they could meet the Mongols with stone castles and light horse.
